title: Turnip Swede Puree
ingredients: About 1 lb of turnips, peeled and cut into large chunks
About 1 lb of swede, peeled and cut into large chunks
method: Boil the turnips and swede in lightly salted water.
Drain the water into a bowl.
Place everything in a food processor and blast to a purée. If necessary add a little of the reserved water to make a smooth purée.
Taste and add salt and pepper and more butter as needed.
